caller_failed_attempt_accounting: Parent must reserve/charge every complete planned attempt before calling fit_head and retain ledger on NumericFailure. This pure helper never retries, drops cells or modifies a caller ledger.

functions.build_variant: build_variant(b, o_D, o_A, c_D, c_A, *, variant, n_D=None, n_A=None) -> phi; variant B/D/ACh/F, rejects supplied withdrawn blocks, exact G/value/T order; natural indicators remain unchanged
functions.epoch_features: epoch_features(times, values, stratum) -> {bins, integral, features, edges}; real strictly ordered seconds and finite values with full bracketing, fixed50ms trapezoids, no baseline/extrapolation
functions.fit_head: fit_head(X, seconds, weights, setting, row_ids, *, limits) -> model; mandatory exact ceiling dict: max_rows,max_features,max_pairs,max_matrix_elements,max_live_float_slots; no internal pair/matrix allocation before preventive check
functions.fit_standardizer: fit_standardizer(values, observed, kinds, weights) -> transform; full rectangular arrays, kinds continuous or indicator; absent continuous values must be None, indicators observed literal0/1
functions.group_weights: group_weights(rows, expected_animals, expected_sessions) -> list[float]; rows each contain row_id, animal, session strings, unique row_id; expected_sessions maps each expected animal to nonempty ordered eligible session IDs, exact complete support required
functions.positive_distance_median: positive_distance_median(X, *, max_pairs) -> exact median of all strictly positive full i<j Euclidean distances, repeated values retained; pair ceiling required
functions.predict_head: predict_head(model, X) -> original-log-time predictions; no clipping/exponentiation, full sealed RBF train rows used
functions.resource_plan: resource_plan(n, p, setting, limits) -> declared full internal scalar-extent plan; no physical RSS/caller-owned arrays guarantee
functions.select_setting: select_setting(loss_rows, validation_animals) -> {setting, joint_loss, objectives}; each loss row has setting_id, animal, stratum, loss; complete20 x animal x4 cells required, exact tie ordering
functions.settings: settings() -> exactly20 {id,family,lambda,width_multiplier} dictionaries; ridge5, RBF3widths x5lambdas
functions.transform: transform_standardizer(state, values, observed) -> rectangular float matrix; constant/unobserved continuous columns always0, indicators unchanged
functions.validation_loss: validation_loss(predicted_log, positive_seconds, rows, expected_animal, expected_sessions, training_variance) -> normalized equal-session MSE
functions.weighted_moments: weighted_moments(values, weights) -> {mean, variance}; positive finite weights sum to one within declared roundoff test, no renormalization

model_target: model["target"] contains mean, variance, scale of original-log fitting targets; predict_head restores original-log units. Parent must not restandardize labels.
numeric_policy: Python binary64 with math.fsum, deterministic row/column order, no jitter/pseudoinverse/retry/subsampling. Dense Cholesky plus declared residual checks; unresolved/nonfinite/underflow or nonpositive pivots fail. No correct-rounding, forward-error or native MATLAB parity claim.
parent_obligations: Authentic support/clock/feature schema/target-alias schedule and training-only admission remain external; whole study, protected targets, source/runtimes and scientific qualification are not this helper.
setting_identity: settings() returns ordered exact dictionaries; consume IDs from it: ridge/lambda=1e-06 and rbf/width=0.5/lambda=1e-06 examples. Required keys id,family,lambda,width_multiplier; ridge width0 comparison-only.
withdrawn_information: Parent constructs and standardizes only retained neural value blocks; build_variant explicitly refuses any withdrawn operand. Shared behavior transform and natural masks G/T remain identical across variants.
